Failed Logins.description: Authentication failures — failed login attempts by user, IP, or source

queries.label: All failed logins in last 24h
queries.dql: stream=authentication where status='FAILED' | duration 1d | groupby user, srcip | limit 20
queries.description: Top users and IPs with failed login attempts

queries.label: Failed logins from public IPs
queries.dql: stream=authentication where status='FAILED' and srctype='PUBLIC' | duration 1d | groupby srcip, user | limit 20
queries.description: External IPs attempting to authenticate

queries.label: Brute force — users with > 5 failures
queries.dql: stream=authentication where status='FAILED' | duration 1d | groupby user, srcip | select user, srcip, count(*) as cnt | having cnt > 5 | limit 20
queries.description: Users or IPs with repeated failed attempts — possible brute force

queries.label: Failed logins by reason
queries.dql: stream=authentication where status='FAILED' | duration 1d | groupby reason, user | limit 20
queries.description: Breakdown by failure reason (BAD_USER_PASSWORD, USER_DISABLED, etc.)

queries.label: Failed logins for disabled accounts
queries.dql: stream=authentication where status='FAILED' and reason='USER_DISABLED' | duration 1d | groupby user, srcip | limit 20
queries.description: Login attempts on disabled accounts — possible credential stuffing

Privilege Changes.description: IAM events — role grants, admin assignments, user enable/disable

queries.label: All privilege changes in last 24h
queries.dql: stream=iam where action='PRIVILEGE_CHANGED' | duration 1d | groupby user, targetuser | limit 20
queries.description: Users whose privileges were changed

queries.label: New users created
queries.dql: stream=iam where action='USER_CREATED' | duration 1d | groupby user, targetuser | limit 20
queries.description: Accounts created in the last 24h

queries.label: Users deleted or deactivated
queries.dql: stream=iam where action in ('USER_DELETED', 'USER_DEACTIVATED', 'USER_SUSPENDED') | duration 1d | groupby user, targetuser | limit 20
queries.description: Accounts removed or suspended

queries.label: Role additions and removals
queries.dql: stream=iam where action in ('ROLE_ADDED', 'ROLE_REMOVED', 'ROLE_UPDATED') | duration 1d | groupby user, targetuser | limit 20
queries.description: Role assignment changes

queries.label: API token created or revoked
queries.dql: stream=iam where action in ('API_TOKEN_CREATED', 'API_TOKEN_REVOKED') | duration 1d | groupby user | limit 20
queries.description: API credential lifecycle events

Destructive Operations.description: Database commands, file deletions, and endpoint file system destruction

queries.label: DROP or TRUNCATE commands on databases
queries.dql: stream=database where action='QUERY-EXECUTED' and rlike(lower(query), '(drop (table|database|view)|truncate table)') | duration 1d | groupby user, srcip | limit 20
queries.description: Destructive database commands executed

queries.label: Bulk file deletions on endpoints
queries.dql: stream=ep-file where action='FILE_DELETED' | duration 1d | groupby user, system | select user, system, count(*) as cnt | having cnt > 20 | limit 20
queries.description: Users or systems with unusually high file deletion counts

queries.label: System files modified on Linux
queries.dql: stream=auditd where action='FILE_MODIFIED' and rlike(targetfilename, '(/etc/|/usr/bin/|/bin/|/sbin/)') | duration 1d | groupby user, system | limit 20
queries.description: Critical system path modifications on Linux hosts

queries.label: Registry deletions on Windows
queries.dql: stream=ep-registry where action='REGISTRY_KEY_DELETED' | duration 1d | groupby user, system | limit 20
queries.description: Registry keys deleted — possible evidence tampering or persistence cleanup

queries.label: Service stops or process terminations
queries.dql: stream=ep-service where action='SERVICE_STOPPED' | duration 1d | groupby user, system, targetservice | limit 20
queries.description: Services stopped — possible defense disruption

Network Connections.description: Firewall and network traffic — allowed/blocked connections, outbound activity

queries.label: All outbound connections to public IPs
queries.dql: stream=firewall where action='PACKET_ALLOWED' and dsttype='PUBLIC' | duration 1d | groupby srcip, dstip | limit 20
queries.description: Internal hosts connecting to the internet

queries.label: Blocked connections — top sources
queries.dql: stream=firewall where action='PACKET_BLOCKED' | duration 1d | groupby srcip | select srcip, count(*) as cnt | having cnt > 50 | limit 20
queries.description: Hosts generating high volumes of blocked traffic

queries.label: Connections on uncommon ports
queries.dql: stream=firewall where action='PACKET_ALLOWED' and dstport not in ('80', '443', '22', '25', '53', '3389') | duration 1d | groupby srcip, dstport | limit 20
queries.description: Traffic on non-standard ports

queries.label: Large outbound data transfers
queries.dql: stream=firewall where srctype='PRIVATE' and dsttype='PUBLIC' and txlen > 200000 | duration 1d | groupby srcip | select srcip, count(*) as cnt | having cnt > 10 | limit 20
queries.description: Hosts sending large volumes of data outbound — possible exfiltration

queries.label: Network connections by NTA
queries.dql: stream=NTA-CONNECTION where srctype='PUBLIC' | duration 1d | groupby srcip, dstip, dstport | limit 20
queries.description: Inbound public connections captured by network traffic analysis

Endpoint Activity.description: Process execution, file writes, and registry changes on endpoints

queries.label: Processes executed in last 24h
queries.dql: stream=ep-process where action='PROCESS_ADDED' | duration 1d | groupby image, user, system | limit 20
queries.description: All process execution events on endpoints

queries.label: PowerShell executions
queries.dql: stream=ep-process where action='PROCESS_ADDED' and image like '%powershell%' | duration 1d | groupby user, system, commandline | limit 20
queries.description: PowerShell process launches — common attacker tool

queries.label: Executables written to disk
queries.dql: stream=ep-file where action='FILE_CREATED' and rlike(lower(targetfilename), '\.(exe|dll|bat|ps1|vbs|sh)$') | duration 1d | groupby user, system, targetfilename | limit 20
queries.description: Executable files written to endpoints

queries.label: Registry run key modifications
queries.dql: stream=ep-registry where rlike(lower(targetobject), '(run|runonce|startup)') | duration 1d | groupby user, system, targetobject | limit 20
queries.description: Persistence mechanism — run key changes

queries.label: Child processes spawned by Office apps
queries.dql: stream=ep-process where action='PROCESS_ADDED' and rlike(lower(parentimage), '(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook)\.exe') | duration 1d | groupby image, parentimage, system | limit 20
queries.description: Office apps spawning child processes — phishing / macro execution

Data Access.description: File and document access, downloads, and uploads from collaboration or storage systems

queries.label: Files downloaded in last 24h
queries.dql: stream=documents where action='DOWNLOADED' | duration 1d | groupby user | select user, count(*) as cnt | having cnt > 10 | limit 20
queries.description: Users downloading large numbers of files

queries.label: Files uploaded with public access
queries.dql: stream=documents where action='UPLOADED' and visibility='PUBLIC' | duration 1d | groupby user | limit 20
queries.description: Files shared publicly — possible data exposure

queries.label: Files accessed from unusual locations
queries.dql: stream=documents where action in ('ACCESSED', 'DOWNLOADED') and srccn in ('CN', 'KP', 'RU', 'IR') | duration 1d | groupby user, srccn | limit 20
queries.description: File access from high-risk countries

queries.label: Database queries with large result sets
queries.dql: stream=database where action='QUERY-EXECUTED' and rowcount > 1000 | duration 1d | groupby user, srcip | limit 20
queries.description: Bulk data reads from databases

queries.label: Sensitive file path access on endpoints
queries.dql: stream=ep-file where action='FILE_ACCESSED' and rlike(lower(targetfilename), '(password|credential|secret|private_key|id_rsa|.aws/credentials)') | duration 1d | groupby user, system, targetfilename | limit 20
queries.description: Access to credential or key files on endpoints
